nodes.title: 《历史与阶级意识》(Geschichte und Klassenbewußtsein, 1923) ⭐
nodes.summary: This partial document provides a brief overview of the book "History and Class Consciousness" (1923) by Georg Lukács, highlighting it as a foundational work of Western Marxism. The document emphasizes three key concepts covered in the book: reification theory, class consciousness, and the method of totality. It also offers various resources for accessing the book, including links to PDF and HTML versions in both Chinese and English, and information on where to borrow the book through Archive.org.

nodes.title: 《社会存在本体论》(Zur Ontologie des gesellschaftlichen Seins)
nodes.summary: This partial document provides information about Georg Lukács's late work "Zur Ontologie des gesellschaftlichen Seins" (Ontology of Social Being), a three-volume treatise focusing on Hegel, Marx, and labor. It lists the Chinese translation published by Chongqing Press in 1993 and the English translations of each volume, which are available as PDFs on marxists.org. The document also includes a search term for locating the Chinese version on Z-Library.
